part.text:
Fixed the bug in `popGenericCommand` (src/t_list.c:548): when LPOP/RPOP is called with a `count` argument on a missing key, it now returns a null array reply (`*-1`) instead of a null bulk reply (`$-1`), matching the documented behavior. Without `count`, the null bulk reply is preserved.

Verified with a raw protocol check (`LPOP key 10` → `*-1\r\n`, `LPOP key` → `$-1\r\n`) and the full `unit/type/list`, `unit/type/list-3`, `unit/multi`, and `unit/scripting` test suites — all pass.
